subject: Re: Quick follow-up + hosted API quickstart (demo recap)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up + hosted API quickstart (demo recap)

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for taking the demo today — really enjoyed seeing the Acme search assistant use case. Quick recap and next steps so we can keep momentum: 

- Hosted API is likely the fastest path to production for you (no infra to manage). It supports text generation, chat, streaming, and embeddings.
- Decision factors we discussed: expected QPS, concurrency, data residency, and whether you need dedicated throughput/SLA for production.

Can you confirm the rough numbers below so we can validate hosted vs Dedicated/Private recommendations: 
1) Expected peak queries per second (QPS) or requests per minute (approx).
2) Typical input/output token lengths for each request (avg prompt tokens + avg response tokens).
3) Any regulatory constraints (must be VPC/on-prem or is Hosted with contractual controls OK).

For immediate evaluation, I attached a short quickstart PDF and a sample-requests.json you can drop into Postman/curl. Highlights for Hosted API evaluation: 
- Quickstart link: https://console.redwood.ai/quickstart/ACME-EX (demo account pre-provisioned)
- Default rate limits for the demo account: 600 requests/minute (burst 1200) and 20 concurrent streaming connections. We can raise those for evaluation if you expect higher traffic.
- Endpoints: /v1/generate (chat & text), /v1/embeddings, /v1/batch.

Proposed next steps: 1) you share the numbers above, 2) we enable a 2-week hosted trial with a higher rate limit for your test tier, 3) schedule a 30-min check-in next week to validate latency and cost.

Thanks — looping Neha (solutions) and Marissa (sales lead) on technical and contractual follow-ups.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0172

Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + hosted API quickstart (demo recap)

Aditya —

Thanks for the recap and the materials. A couple of quick answers and follow-ups from our side: 

1) Traffic: our pilot will target ~80 QPS at peak for the search assistant (roughly 4.8k req/min). Peak bursts could hit ~150 QPS during marketing events.
2) Tokens: avg prompt ~120 tokens, avg response ~220 tokens.
3) Compliance: Hosted is fine for the pilot as long as we have standard contractual controls (DPA + security addendum). For full prod we may need a VPC in a year, but pilot is fine hosted.

Questions: 
- Can you confirm how billing works for streaming responses (per-token?) and if we can see per-request token breakdowns in the console?
- You mentioned rate-limit increases for trials — is that something we can get enabled immediately for our demo account?

If we can get a short trial with higher limits and recording of per-request tokens, we can run an end-to-end pilot this week. Tom and I are available Thursday or Friday for the check-in.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Jones
Product Manager, Acme Corp
sarah.jones@acme.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 11:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + hosted API quickstart (demo recap)

Thanks Sarah — perfect, that helps a lot. Quick answers inline and next steps: 

> Traffic: ~80 QPS (4.8k req/min), bursts ~150 QPS
- For the pilot numbers you shared, Hosted API should be fine. We’ll provision a trial tier with a higher rate-limit to cover 200 QPS burst behavior. If you see sustained traffic above ~250 QPS we typically recommend Redwood Dedicated for predictable throughput and lower per-token unit costs.

> Tokens: prompt ~120 / response ~220
- Billing: yes, streaming and non-streaming responses are billed per token (prompt + completion). The console shows per-request token usage and you can export logs for token-by-token breakdowns.

> Compliance: pilot ok hosted
- We’ll attach the standard DPA/security addendum through Marissa; for now hosted evaluation is fully supported.

I’ve requested a rate-limit increase on your demo account to 6k req/min (sustained) with 400 QPS burst; should be active within 2 business hours. You’ll get a note when live. I’ve also attached a sample cURL payload (sample-requests.json) — that should help replicate your traffic profile.

Proposed meeting: Thu 07/22 10:00 AM PT (30 min) — to validate latency under load and walk through console token logs. Does that work for you?

Thanks — Neha will confirm the rate-limit change and Marissa will send the DPA.

-Aditya
